units.source_text: “如果得不到旧恋人的宽恕，还是不能有新恋人。”

en.t: "If I cannot obtain my former lover's forgiveness, I still cannot have a new lover."

units.source_text: 町子将这样的话写在信里，想从屋顶上给少年扔下去，才从铁梯子爬了上来。

en.t: Machiko had written those words in a letter and climbed up the iron ladder, intending to drop it from the roof to the boy below.
